sources.title: AI model submits false tip on Philadelphia Police unsolved homicide case

sources.title: chiakiidn/perceiver-multitask-tiny · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Overview A small Perceiver implementation for Multitask, packaged with an explicit configuration and an initialization checkpoint. The tiny variant is a reproducible starting point, not a trained model release.

sources.title: Perceiver - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This is the configuration class to store the configuration of a PerceiverModel. It is used to instantiate an Perceiver model according to the specified arguments, defining the model architecture. Instantiating a configuration with the defaults will yield a similar configuration to that of the Perceiver deepmind/language-perceiver architecture.
